schema.title: Dot1x Troubleshoot Large-Data Input Schema
schema.description: Exercises the proposed x-itential-payload-type file decorator convention. Large results (pre-check, dot1x session detail, running-config) are written by Gateway 5 to temp files and passed to the script as env vars instead of inline payload fields, then cleaned up after execution.

target_device.description: Name/identifier of the device being troubleshot

network_os.description: Device OS/platform, used to select the right parsing logic

pre_check_success.description: Whether the upstream pre-check task passed

pre_check_result_json.description: Pre-check results, written to a temp file by Gateway 5 rather than inlined

dot1x_detail_result_json.description: Full dot1x session detail (potentially thousands of entries), written to a temp file by Gateway 5 rather than inlined

running_config_result_json.description: Full running-config (can be MBs of text), written to a temp file by Gateway 5 rather than inlined

services.name: itential-large-data-test
services.description: Cross-references dot1x-enabled interfaces against live session state using large-data payloads passed as files rather than inline decorator fields.
